packs.title: Midnight Dive
packs.tagline: Deep blue orbital gradients for calm focus.
packs.useCase: best for long work blocks, late-night planning, and screens that need to feel quieter.
packs.blurb: A colder, cleaner roost palette for when the browser should feel like a cockpit instead of a carnival.

packs.title: Sunrise Thermals
packs.tagline: Warm launch colors for days that need momentum.
packs.useCase: best for morning starts, launch days, and any session that needs a little lift off the runway.
packs.blurb: A warmer pack with lift-off energy: still moody, but less bunker and more early-morning launch pad.

packs.title: Signal Bloom
packs.tagline: Violet-green contrast for playful terminals and loud tabs.
packs.useCase: best for playful work, demo days, and when the browser can afford to look a little feral.
packs.blurb: The slightly unhinged pack. Still readable, just with more ‘bird found a synth’ energy.
